cases.prompt: Be the orchestrator for this five-PR build.
I'm offline until tomorrow morning, so keep the four parallel workstreams on the checkout rewrite moving, merge whatever passes review, and leave me a list of what needs my call.
Split the search-index rebuild into pieces separate workers can build side by side, decide who owns which files, and set up who reviews each PR before it merges.
Your context just got compacted halfway through the build, so pick back up running the Codex peers and the review queue from where you left off.
Claude subagents will write the code and Codex will review every PR, so work out how approvals and merges should be gated across all of them.
Implement spec 012 phase by phase until everything in its plan.md is done.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: one agent executing one numbered spec belongs to implement.

cases.prompt: Keep watching CI on PR #57 and fix whatever fails until it goes green.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: one loop against one CI signal belongs to autonomous-loops.

cases.prompt: Write the instructions for a subagent that will add pagination to the orders API, including what it should report back when it finishes.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: writing one brief and its report contract belongs to agent-briefs.
